sentences.text: Researchers employed the MADM genetic technique to track individual cell lineages and single-cell methods to examine how the Pten gene influences the development of radial glial cells in the cortex.
When the Pten gene was removed, the number of projection neurons produced by these cells doubled, while the production of astrocytes in the cortex increased significantly.
Experiments indicated that without Pten, the process of making astrocytes becomes disconnected from normal growth factor signals and instead relies on the MAPK signaling pathway.
The findings suggest that the Pten gene controls the development of radial glial cells in a step-by-step manner to ensure the cortex grows to the correct size.
